_comment: Bash permission allowlist for the SQA-loop suite. Merge the `permissions.allow` array
below into your ~/.claude/settings.json, or run `.\install.ps1 -MergeSettings` to have
it merged for you (it backs up settings.json first).
THESE ARE A CONVENIENCE, NOT A SECURITY BOUNDARY. Skipping them costs you approval
prompts, nothing else -- the specialists still work. The actual boundary is the pair of
PreToolUse guards in ~/.claude/hooks/, which are an allowlist (the SQA specialists) and a
protected-path scope guard (the fixer). Do not confuse the two: settings.json entries say
'do not ask me about this', the hooks say 'this may not happen at all'.
Prefix matching: `Bash(git status*)` matches any command starting `git status`. The
trailing `*` matters. Paths use `~`, which Claude Code expands per-user.
Every entry here is read-only or test-running. Nothing in this list mutates a repository.
